title: Parcels exactly on a weight limit are charged the next tier
description: shippingCost in src/shippingRates.js charges a parcel that weighs exactly 1 kg at the 1-5 kg rate, and a parcel of exactly 20 kg is refused as too heavy. A tier covers parcels up to and including its limit.
measures: Bug in a file larger than 20 KB (truncation risk, known weak spot)
